$comment: Extra folder-name rules for import, on top of the generic ones in
src/core/io/folder-tags.ts. Copy this to folder-rules.json and edit.
folder-rules.json is gitignored on purpose: the folder names in a real
bookmark tree are personal data. Client names, employers, course codes and
hobbies all end up in there, and none of it belongs in a repository.
Generic rules ship in code and need no configuration: browser containers
(Bookmarks bar, Other bookmarks, Imported, New folder, Unsorted Bookmarks),
date-stamped folder names in three formats, and course-day dividers
(Day 1 / Day1). Everything below is for names only you would have.
Matching is case-insensitive. Patterns are regular expressions.
structural  filing containers that should not become tags
session     saved tab sets: not tags, and their contents import to the inbox
rather than the library, since a tab dump is a triage queue
